content.value: A simple harmonic motion is represented by $y = 1 2 \mathrm { s i n } ( 6 t - \frac { \pi } { 3 } )$ where y is measured in meters, t in seconds, and the phase angle in radians. Calculate the (i) frequency, (ii) epoch, (ii) maximum velocity and acceleration, and (iv) displacement at t=0 and t=6 seconds.
